text: This report recommends that the name "Andy Olvet Lane" be approved to identify a public lane west of Kippendavie Avenue extending between Kewbeach Avenue and Buller Avenue. Community Councils have delegated authority to decide street naming matters which comply with the City of Toronto Street Naming Policy.
The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Approved the name "Andy Olvet Lane" for a public lane west of Kippendavie Avenue extending between Kewbeach Avenue and Buller Avenue.
